_comment: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search index definition for the `documentchunks` collection. This deployment runs on local standalone MongoDB (no Atlas), so vector-store.ts auto-detects that and falls back to in-memory brute-force cosine similarity — this file is not executable here. When the app moves to MongoDB Atlas, create this index (Atlas UI: Database > Search > Create Search Index > JSON Editor, or `mongosh`/Atlas CLI) on the `documentchunks` collection so vector-store.ts's runtime capability probe picks it up automatically; no code changes are needed.
name: document_chunk_vector_index
